basic_details.job_title: TISS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Field Coordinator, Supervisor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, a deemed university and grant-in-aid institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is inviting applications for two project positions in its School Initiative for Mental Health Advocacy (SIMHA): one Field Coordinator and one Supervisor (part-time). Applications with an updated and detailed CV go by email to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026, and late applications will not be entertained.

qualification.details: Both positions are for a duration of 04 months, subject to extension of the project. The location for both is TISS, Mumbai Campus, with travel across districts in Maharashtra. The Supervisor post is part-time, 3 days in a week. | Master's degree in Psychology or Social Work with a minimum 2 years' experience. Prior experience in working with children and adolescents, school settings or in socio-emotional learning programs. Good writing and communication skills in English and Marathi. Proficiency in Marathi is necessary for this role. Proficiency in the use of computers for documentation, data analysis and use of virtual platforms for training. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in counselling and psychotherapy, experience of programme delivery and implementation in school settings, and prior experience working on government programs, particularly within Maharashtra. Preference will also be given to candidates based in Nashik, Thane, Nagpur or Amravati districts of Maharashtra, as the role requires travel across different districts in Maharashtra. | Master's degree in Psychology with a minimum 3 years experience. Prior experience in working with children and adolescents, school settings or in socio-emotional learning programs. Good writing and communication skills in English and Marathi/Hindi. Proficiency in the use of computers for documentation, data analysis and use of virtual platforms for training. Preference will be given to candidates with formal training as a supervisor, experience in counselling and psychotherapy supervision of school counsellors, experience of programme delivery and implementation in school settings, and prior experience working on government programs, particularly within Maharashtra. Preference will also be given to candidates based in Nashik, Nagpur or Amravati districts of Maharashtra. | The notice states no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

selection_process: Applications received will be shortlisted. Possessing the qualifications and experience will not ensure an interview call. Only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed through online platforms. The notice does not describe how interview marks or final selection are decided.
important_instructions: The name of the position applied for must be clearly mentioned in the email subject line. Late applications will not be entertained. Both positions are for 04 months, subject to extension of the project. The selected candidate will be required to join on 01 December 2026. Interviews of shortlisted candidates will be held through online platforms.

content_sections.heading: About SIMHA
content_sections.text: Launched in 2017, the School Initiative for Mental Health Advocacy (SIMHA) is an advocacy, research and capacity-building field action project of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Mumbai. SIMHA supports schools through knowledge sharing and training of school leaders, teachers and counsellors, and promotes the well-being and mental health of children and adolescents.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application with an updated and detailed CV to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026. The subject line of the email must clearly mention the name of the position applied for. Enquiries can be sent to the same email address. The notice is signed by the Project Director, Dr. Chetna Duggal. The notice prints no postal address for applications and no form to use.

content_sections.heading: TISS SIMHA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct regular visits to the 37 partner schools to monitor programme implementation and quality. Observe counsellor sessions in school, and provide real-time feedback; assess school climate and mental health awareness. Liaise with principals, school staff and government officials. Support counsellors in conducting stakeholder sessions and well-being activities, and relay feedback to supervisors. Provide on-site support for special circumstances or urgent requirements. Develop well-being resources as needs arise for schools or the programme. Hold regular coordination and progress meetings with government partners. Any other duties assigned by the Programme Coordinator or Director. Supervisors report directly to the Project Director and Programme Manager. They play a role in mentoring and supervision of school counsellors in Maharashtra's EMRS schools. The job profile involves: Providing mentorship and supervision (individual and group) to school counsellors for implementing a well-being and career program with high school students. Providing the same mentorship for conducting group sessions with students in an effective and ethical manner. Providing the same mentorship for conducting teacher capacity building sessions, parent engagement sessions and mental health promotion activities in schools. Providing the same mentorship for liaising with stakeholders and ensuring quality of programme delivery, adhering to ethical standards of practice. Preparing and maintaining reports documenting supervision sessions including key learnings and actionable insights. Field visits across districts in Maharashtra (Nashik, Thane, Nagpur, and Amravati) to review counsellors' work. Any other responsibilities assigned by the project director and project coordinator.
